title: Game Engine
summary: A from-scratch C++ game engine—public so the machinery stays inspectable.
problem: Heavy commercial engines hide the loop, the renderer, and the trade-offs. We wanted a core we own and can read end to end.
approach: Building the engine in C++, openly, system by system. The repository is the documentation of what works and what we are still shaping.
outcome: A living public codebase the lab can grow, study against, and use as a foundation for experiments.
